第十五章神秘忍者
眼看黑衣人就要死在黄金比蒙的脚下了，众人微微欣喜之际。又一道黑烟缓缓升起。黄金比蒙一脚踏空，低头一看，黑衣人的身影已经消失的无影无踪了。几秒之后，黑烟闪起，黑衣人再次出现在几十米之外。双眼炽热的注释着受了重伤的黄金比蒙。看他的样子好像在看一件至宝一般。
“吼，”黑衣人的眼神彻底的激怒了黄金比蒙，只见其怒吼一声。强压住体内攻心的剧毒。脚下一蹬，顿时黄土地面龟裂了下来。化为一条幻影直接冲向黑衣人。如今的黑衣人已经不能够再次施展隐身。依靠着本身那可怜的一点力量，速度根本快不起来，又如何能够躲避掉着一击呢。
黄金比蒙那被金黄色覆盖的强力的右爪。狠狠地砸向黑衣人。“啪！”一股恐怖的力量砸在了黑衣人的身体表面，就在众人以为他必死之时。黑衣人的衣服忽然闪烁起一道诡异的黑色光芒，竟成功的当住了这强力一击。可是力量是有传递的，就好比。黑衣人躲在一辆坚固的马车里。别人攻击到马车，虽然黑衣人本人没受伤。可是马车本身却被砸飞了。黑衣人自然也跟着被砸飞了。
现在就是这种情况。黑衣人整个人都被砸地飞了起来。而后狠狠的撞在身后的巨树之上。第一颗巨树被这股冲击力撞击的完全碎裂开来。可是黑衣人却因为衣服上诡异的黑光而毫发未伤。接着第二棵，第三棵，....一直到第五棵，才卸掉着强大的冲击力量。
他一骨碌爬起来，回想着刚刚的那股强大力量，感受着身前护符的能量消耗。第一次失去了冷静，脸上汗水直流。不敢置信的看着眼前的一切。
“不能继续下去，否则这暗影守护会崩溃的。”黑衣人最大的依仗就是暗影守护，这是此次出来，他的父亲也就是族长藤原千方听说要去猎杀黄金比蒙，偷偷交给他的。这强大的戒指足足可以帮助他抵挡三次以上特级忍者的攻击。
但是就在刚刚被受了重伤的黄金比蒙重击了一拳之后，黑衣人也就是藤原百峰，清楚的感觉到暗影守护里面的能量已经不足二分之一了。
也就是说，如果在被打中一下，自己很有可能就死定了。“好，好，黑环啊，你居然还能请到有魔法防具的家伙，看来你为了今天真的是用了不少的工夫，但是今天我就让你的一切诡计全都破灭。”黄金比蒙毫不停留的向着黑衣人－藤原百峰大步走去。看来是想先杀死这个身上好东西成出不穷的家伙。
“呼！”藤原百峰猛然一窜，就朝身后的一颗大树窜了过去。
“咻！”黄金比蒙右脚狠狠的踢了过去，后法先至，直接抽在了藤原百峰的身上。藤原百峰整个人狠狠砸在大树边沿上，撞断了无数树枝。
沿着老根滚到了地上，黄金比蒙脚下一蹬再次飞出出去，地面寸寸龟裂。“你还想逃？”右脚再一次向着他的身体踏上，而此时藤原百峰的暗影守护里面的能量已经用的七七八八了。如果这一脚踢出，他肯定是必死无疑。
到了这个时候，藤原百峰已经遗忘了紧张与害怕，毕竟只要这一脚落下，马上一命呜呼，现在唯一可以的就是自救，自救帮助自己。而如何自我帮助，那么一定要依靠自己的强大技能，隐身了。
而巧合的是，在黄金比蒙右脚踏下的前一刻。藤原百峰脑袋里面一片空明，计算着隐身完成的时间。“隐身。”技能刚刚冷却完毕，藤原百峰立即大叫了出来，再次凭空消失，而之后，连一秒的时间都没有，黄金比蒙的脚落了下来，在地上踏出寸寸裂痕。
保护少主，保护少主。就在这时，不远处的丛林中突然传出大叫。听到这样的声音，黑衣人立即闪到距离从来最近的地方。
“黄金比蒙，你今天必死无疑。”藤原百峰大喜，在这个时候，他听见了他叔叔也就是族中长老的声音，要知道他的叔叔可是百年难得一遇的天才，年仅45岁就升到了上忍，现在应该已经达到上忍的巅峰境界。
只要他保护着自己，自己还有什么危险呢。
“哼，来一个是杀，来两个也是杀，有多少，杀多少。”黄金比蒙此刻杀气奔腾，闪烁着通红的双眼。
“咻。”就在黄金比蒙准备再给他一击的时候，他的身后凭空再次出现一个黑衣人，只是他的声息更小，没有一丝黑雾。直接那剑刺了出去。
感受到这一剑的危险，黄金比蒙整个汗毛都竖了起来。没有犹豫，左拳向后凶猛挥出。

“蓬，”那柄长剑划过长空，刚好和黄金比蒙的左拳交击在一起。
那黑衣人只感到一股汹涌澎湃的能量顺着手中的长剑传人自己的身体，同时还有一股凌厉的冲击力向着自己。黑衣人果断的松开手中长剑，可依旧被那股强大的冲击力撞飞，在空中连续翻了几翻才抵消了冲击力，落到地上。
“噗，噗，”两人口中同时吐出一股鲜血，看着黄金比蒙的样子，好像身体已经到了极限，就要不行了。而失去了武器的黑衣人，也捂住胸口，靠着身后的大树。大口大口的喘息着，一看就知道受了不轻的伤。
这时藤原百峰的声音也在远处的丛林中传了出来：“大家给我上，杀死他奖励黄金万两，神兵一把，美姬百人，上级忍级一部，。”随着藤原百峰充满诱惑的声音喊出，他身后的7,8个忍者模样的人，看着重伤的黄金比蒙，眼中都泛起了红色的光芒，完全忘记了他强大的实力。
一个个不要命的冲了上去。
看着冲来的众多忍者，脸上带着诡异笑容的黑环巨蟒，和躲在身后欲要伺机而动的最强黑衣人。黄金比蒙感受着体内的毒液的快速流散，知道今天是命悬一线，基本上是没有什么希望了。
再次仰天怒吼“嗜血狂暴。”
一个好似全金造成的黄金比蒙再次出现在众人的眼前，紧接着原本气息微弱的黄金比蒙再次战意冲天，给人一种完全没有受过伤的样子。【明天星期天，肯定爆发，大家务必支持下。谢谢！】

Chapter 15 Mysterious Ninja
Seeing that the man in black was about to die at the feet of Golden Behemoth, everyone was slightly happy.又一道黑烟缓缓升起。 Golden Behemoth stepped into the air, looked down and saw that the figure of the man in black had disappeared without a trace. A few seconds later, black smoke flashed up, and the man in black appeared again dozens of meters away. His eyes were blazing as he looked at the seriously injured Golden Behemoth.看他的样子好像在看一件至宝一般。
"Roar," the man in black's eyes completely angered Golden Behemoth, and he roared angrily.强压住体内攻心的剧毒。 As soon as his feet kicked off, the loess ground suddenly cracked.化为一条幻影直接冲向黑衣人。 Now the man in black can no longer use invisibility again. Relying on his own pitiful strength, he couldn't get up to speed at all, so how could he dodge a blow.
Golden Behemoth's powerful right claw is covered in golden color.狠狠地砸向黑衣人。 "Bang!" A terrifying force hit the surface of the man in black's body, just when everyone thought he was going to die. The clothes of the man in black suddenly flashed with a strange black light, and he successfully withstood this powerful blow.可是力量是有传递的，就好比。黑衣人躲在一辆坚固的马车里。 Others attacked the carriage, although the man in black himself was not injured.可是马车本身却被砸飞了。黑衣人自然也跟着被砸飞了。
现在就是这种情况。黑衣人整个人都被砸地飞了起来。而后狠狠的撞在身后的巨树之上。 The first giant tree was completely shattered by the impact. But the man in black was unscathed because of the strange black light on his clothes. Then the second tree, the third tree,... until the fifth tree, the powerful impact force was released.
He jumped up, recalling the powerful force just now, and feeling the energy consumption of the talisman in front of him.第一次失去了冷静，脸上汗水直流。不敢置信的看着眼前的一切。
"We can't continue, otherwise the Shadow Guardian will collapse." The man in black's biggest reliance is the Shadow Guardian, which was given to him secretly by his father, the clan leader Chikata Fujiwara, after he heard that he was going to hunt down Golden Behemoth. This powerful ring can help him withstand more than three attacks from super ninjas.
But just after being punched hard by the seriously injured Golden Behemoth, the man in black, Fujiwara Momamine, clearly felt that the energy in the Shadow Guard was less than half.
In other words, if you were hit once, you would probably be dead. "Okay, okay, Black Ring, you can actually invite a guy with magic armor. It seems that you have really worked hard for today, but today I will destroy all your tricks." Golden Behemoth strode towards the man in black - Fujiwara Momamine without stopping. It seems that he wants to kill this guy who has endless good things in him first.
"Huh!" Fujiwara Momofeng suddenly jumped towards a big tree behind him.
"Whoops!" Golden Behemoth kicked hard with his right foot, and the latter came first, hitting Fujiwara Momamine directly. Fujiwara Momamine hit the edge of the big tree hard, breaking countless branches.
Rolling along the old roots to the ground, Golden Behemoth kicked off his feet and flew out again, the ground cracked every inch. "Do you still want to escape?" The right foot stepped towards his body again, and at this time, the energy in Fujiwara Momamine's Shadow Guard had been exhausted. If this kick was taken, he would definitely die.
By this time, Fujiwara Momamine has forgotten his nervousness and fear. After all, as long as this kick falls, he will die immediately. The only thing he can do now is to save himself and help himself. As for how to help yourself, you must rely on your own powerful skills to become invisible.
Coincidentally, the moment before Golden Behemoth stepped on his right foot,carve. Fujiwara Momamine's head was blank, counting the time until the invisibility was completed. "Invisibility." As soon as the skill was cooled down, Fujiwara Momamine immediately shouted out and disappeared out of thin air again. And then, without even a second, Golden Behemoth's feet fell down, leaving cracks on the ground.
Protect the young master, protect the young master. At this moment, a shout suddenly came from the jungle not far away. Hearing such a sound, the man in black immediately moved to the nearest place.
"Golden Behemoth, you will definitely die today." Fujiwara Momamine was overjoyed. At this time, he heard the voice of his uncle, the elder of the clan. You must know that his uncle is a genius that is rare in a century. He was promoted to jounin at the age of 45 and should have reached the pinnacle of jounin by now.
As long as he protects himself, what danger is there to him?
"Hmph, if one comes, it's a kill, if two come, it's a kill, as many as there are, kill as many as you want." Golden Behemoth was filled with murderous intent at this moment, his eyes flashing red.
"Phew." Just when Golden Behemoth was about to give him another blow, a man in black appeared out of thin air again behind him, but his voice was softer and there was no trace of black mist. The sword stabbed out directly.
Feeling the danger of this sword, Golden Behemoth's whole hair stood up. Without hesitation, he swung his left fist backward fiercely.
"Peng," the long sword crossed the sky and happened to collide with Golden Behemoth's left fist.
The man in black only felt a surging energy flowing into his body along the long sword in his hand, and at the same time there was a sharp impact towards him. The man in black decisively let go of the sword in his hand, but was still knocked away by the powerful impact. He flipped several times in the air before the impact was offset, and he fell to the ground.
"Pfft, pfft," the two of them spit out a stream of blood at the same time. Looking at Golden Behemoth, it seemed that their bodies had reached their limit and were about to die. The man in black, who had lost his weapon, covered his chest and leaned against the tree behind him. He was panting heavily, and it was obvious at first glance that he was seriously injured.
At this time, Fujiwara Momamine's voice also came out from the distant jungle: "Come on, everyone, I will reward you with ten thousand liang of gold for killing him, a magic weapon, a hundred beautiful girls, and a superior ninja." As Fujiwara Momamine's seductive voice shouted, the 7 or 8 ninja-like people behind him looked at the seriously injured Golden Behemoth, with a red light in their eyes, completely forgetting his powerful strength.
One by one, they rushed forward desperately.
Looking at the many ninjas rushing towards them, the black-ringed giant python with a strange smile on his face, and the strongest man in black hiding behind him, waiting for an opportunity. Golden Behemoth felt the venom in his body dissipate rapidly, knowing that his life was hanging by a thread today, and there was basically no hope.
He looked up to the sky again and roared "bloodthirsty and violent."
A Golden Behemoth that seemed to be made of all gold appeared in front of everyone again, and then the originally weak Golden Behemoth once again became full of fighting spirit, giving people a completely uninjured appearance. [It will definitely break out tomorrow, Sunday, and everyone must support it. Thanks! 】
